title: Krahn--Szegő type inequalities and nodal domain methods on graphs
summary: We study discrete analogues of classical spectral geometric inequalities and extremal eigenvalue problems on graphs. The classical Krahn--Szegő inequality states that, among bounded open subsets of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with fixed volume, the minimum of $λ_2(Ω)$ is attained by the union of two congruent balls. Firstly, we establish a Krahn--Szegő type inequality for trees. For trees with a fixed number of interior vertices and boundary leaves, we completely characterize the extremal structures that minimize the second Dirichlet eigenvalue.
